# .github/workflows

GitHub Actions workflow definitions implementing CI/CD pipeline for the git-lanes project, including test matrix execution, npm publishing with provenance, automated release notes generation, and stale issue/PR management.

## Contents

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [ci.yml](./ci.yml) | Defines `test` job with matrix strategy (os: ubuntu-latest/macos-latest, bun-version: latest), runs `bun install`, `bunx --bun tsc --noEmit`, `bun test` against test/unit, test/security, test/integration, test/e2e; `ci-complete` job validates `needs.test.result` equals `success` |
| [publish.yml](./publish.yml) | CI/CD workflow triggered on `v*` tags; `test` job runs `bun test` via `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2`; `publish` job (needs: test) executes `bun run build`, `npm publish --provenance` with `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` from `secrets.NPM_TOKEN`, requires `id-token: write` permission |
| [release-notes.yml](./release-notes.yml) | Auto-generates changelog on `v*` tag push using `actions/checkout@v4` and `softprops/action-gh-release@v2` with `generate_release_notes: true`; runs on `ubuntu-latest` with `contents: write` permission |
| [stale.yml](./stale.yml) | Marks stale issues/PRs using `actions/stale@v9` on `cron: 0 0 * * 0`; `days-before-stale: 60`, `days-before-close: 14`; applies `stale-issue-label`, `stale-pr-label: stale`; exempts `pinned,security` labels |

## Triggers

| Event Pattern | Workflow |
|---------------|----------|
| `push`/`pull_request` to `main` | [ci.yml](./ci.yml) |
| `push` tags `v*` | [publish.yml](./publish.yml), [release-notes.yml](./release-notes.yml) |
| `cron: 0 0 * * 0` | [stale.yml](./stale.yml) |

## Job Dependencies

```
ci.yml:        test → ci-complete (always(), validates needs.test.result)
publish.yml:   test → publish (needs: test)
release-notes.yml: standalone (no job dependencies)
stale.yml:     standalone (cron-triggered)
```

## Actions Used

| Action | Version | Workflows |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| `actions/checkout` | v4 | ci.yml, release-notes.yml |
| `oven-sh/setup-bun` | v2 | ci.yml, publish.yml |
| `softprops/action-gh-release` | v2 | release-notes.yml |
| `actions/stale` | v9 | stale.yml |

## Required Secrets

| Secret | Workflow | Usage |
|--------|----------|-------|
| `NPM_TOKEN` | publish.yml | `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` for `npm publish --provenance` |

## Test Structure Coverage

[ci.yml](./ci.yml) executes full test suite:
- Unit: `test/unit`
- Security: `test/security`
- Integration: `test/integration`
- E2E: `test/e2e`
